title: Naming Without Naming
subtitle: named, and still wild
mapEpigraph: There is a way to name a bird while leaving it in the sky.

prompts.text: What past ideas were flattened by premature explanation?
What words let the current calling stay alive rather than making it perform?
Without a plan attached: what is calling?

blocks.title: Without the verbs
blocks.instruction: Write one sentence without the verbs launch, build, scale, achieve, or complete. Keep it private.

blocks.closing: When asked what you are working on, resist the pitch once.
